subject: 🐋 Welcome to MindSync (and one quick question)
preview: One thing to try today, and one question from me.
h1_bold: Therapy happens once a week. Life happens in between.

blocks.alt: Illustration: an orca tail rising over waves in front of a coral sun

blocks.text: I'm Darek, one of the people building MindSync. We made it for the days between sessions: the thought you want to bring next time, the habit you're trying to keep, the evening when you just need to talk something through.

Open Reflect and talk to Orca for five minutes. Say what's on your mind, out loud or in writing. Orca isn't a therapist and doesn't replace yours. It keeps short notes from your talks so it can remember you, and you can read or delete them any time in Settings.

blocks.alt: Two MindSync screens: a Reflect conversation with Orca, and the What Orca remembers page

blocks.text: What brought you to MindSync? Just hit reply. One sentence is plenty. I read every answer myself, and they shape a lot of what we build next.

footer_promise: We promise to only send you mental health-related tips & updates.

footer_image.alt: Illustration: a lighthouse on a cliff, a sailboat and a coral sun

crisis_line: MindSync isn't a crisis service. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US, or find a local helpline at findahelpline.com.
